question: Why does IBM have no revenue rows under the RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax concept?
summary: IBM shows zero rows for the RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax concept because it does not use that XBRL tag for its revenue data. Instead, IBM reports all revenue through the legacy Revenues concept, which has 235 rows spanning fiscal years 2009‑2026. This pattern is likely due to IBM not having adopted ASC 606‑based contract‑revenue tagging in its filings.

verified_claims.text: IBM has 0 rows for the concept RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax.
IBM has 235 rows for the concept Revenues.
The only revenue‑related concept IBM uses is Revenues (235 rows).
IBM’s Revenues concept spans fiscal years 2009 through 2026.
IBM has 0 rows with NULL period_frame for the RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax concept.

inferences.text: The absence of the ASC 606 tag suggests IBM has not adopted ASC 606 reporting in its XBRL filings.
IBM continues to tag revenue with the legacy Revenues concept rather than updating to the newer contract‑revenue concept.

H-5700b4.text: Data‑artifact: IBM’s XBRL filings tag revenue only with the legacy 'Revenues' concept; the newer 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' concept is absent because IBM has not updated its taxonomy tagging.
H-5700b4.why: IBM tags revenue only with the legacy Revenues concept; the newer concept is absent.

H-3b6fe1.text: Data‑artifact: IBM’s rows for that concept exist but are filtered out because they have a NULL period_frame (indicating duplicate/follow‑on filings) and the view excludes NULL period_frame values.
H-3b6fe1.why: There are zero rows with NULL period_frame for the concept, so hiding due to NULL period_frame does not apply.

H-2ff39e.text: Real‑world: IBM has not adopted ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers) reporting, so it does not populate the RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax concept in its XBRL submissions.
H-2ff39e.why: No ASC 606 concept appears, indicating IBM has not adopted ASC 606 reporting.

H-0dcf41.text: Real‑world: IBM reports revenue using other US‑GAAP elements (e.g., RevenueFromLicensingArrangements, ServiceRevenue) rather than the generic contract‑revenue concept, so the specific concept is intentionally omitted.
H-0dcf41.why: IBM does not use other revenue concepts; it relies solely on Revenues.

LIMIT 200
